question: FIH Men's Hockey World Cup 2018 was organised by which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The FIH Men's Hockey World Cup 2018** was organized by **India.**
 
• The tournament took place in **Bhubaneswar and Cuttack, Odisha,** from **November 28 to December 16, 2018.**
 
• This was the 14th edition of the **Men's Hockey World Cup, and the Kalinga Stadium in Bhubaneswar **served as the main venue for the matches.
 
• The event featured teams from around the world competing for the prestigious title of **world champions in field hockey.**
 
• Belgium emerged as the winners, defeating the Netherlands in a thrilling final to claim their **first-ever Men's Hockey World Cup.**
